name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: health cover for low-income households
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE SEED DATA. Criteria are simplified for the prototype and are not a substitute for the official scheme guidelines; replace before any real use.

criteria.clause_text: Eligibility is limited to households with annual income not exceeding Rs 1,20,000.
Households covered by ESIC or CGHS are excluded.
The applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
